extracted.intended_audience: clinical trialists, trial methodologists, authors reporting trials, journal editors, and guideline developers
extracted.subtask_description: Use the SPIRIT and CONSORT extension checklists/statements to report clinical trials that deviate from the standard two‑group parallel design (different designs, interventions, or data). The page lists available extensions (by design, data, intervention) and links to statements, checklists, explanations, and additional materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use extensions for non-standard trial designs/interventions/data
rubrics_metrics.description: The main SPIRIT and CONSORT Statements are based on the 'standard' two-group parallel design; many trials vary in design, interventions, or data. To improve reporting of these trials, the main Statements have been extended or modified for various areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select and apply the relevant SPIRIT or CONSORT extension when your trial departs from the standard two-group parallel design (examples given include cluster designs, non-pharmacological interventions, harms data). The list on the page presents extensions by design, data, and interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension development policy / registration
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are interested in developing a new SPIRIT or CONSORT extension, the site directs you to review the extension policy and register your interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the published extension policy and complete the provided short registration form to register interest in developing a new extension.
